# 06 zzuFuzz — voicing round (Batch 3A, the fat and driven set)

*Generated by tests/voicing/batch03a.py. Level reading: RMS over the note-on region of the wall phrase (phrase k); matched to the bank reference (−18.0 dBFS RMS) by VOLUME; phrase (b)'s reading is in the table too. Every change is before → after under the echo rule. WAVs are on the listen/batch-03a-chapter1-fat-and-driven branch only.*

**Recommended: B centre** — POLY (6 voices), every voice two saws 9 cents apart, both oscillators at full tilt, per-voice DRIVE 100 into GROWL 76 (BIAS 45, TONE 55), the filter open (24 dB, CUTOFF 88, RESO 80) and the amp at full sustain, dry (ALLEY, DRAIN, CHEW 0). The wall: the held A2's crest factor is 2.3 dB (GROWL 0 on the same patch: 5.8; a square wave is 0, a sine 3), and the 3 s hold loses 0.1 dB from its first to its last half second. Attack: AMP ATTACK 20 = 2.4 ms by the engine's time table; measured, the voice alone rises 10-90 % in 2.0 ms and the fuzzed note in 2.0 ms, with the level -0.7 dB at 2 ms and -0.1 dB at 10 ms re its plateau (from silence). The tail: -60 dB 274 ms after a 3 s note, 314 ms after the held chord. RESO 80 is nowhere near singing: the noise-fed filter answers a 12 dB drop in its input with 12.0 dB at RESO 100, 12.0 at 115, 11.8 at 120, and starts to sing at 3.3 at 124 and 0.3 at 127. Centroid 1656 Hz; level -17.9 dBFS on the wall phrase, -16.0 on phrase (b) (the chords of phrase (b) read +1.9 dB over the wall phrase), peak -12.4, crest 5.5 dB over the phrase; worst case 1414 host instr/sample. C is fiercer (GROWL 104, BIAS 72, TONE 64: centroid 2058 Hz, hold crest 1.7 dB); D is DUAL (four saws a note: 1964 instr/sample, VOLUME 61).

## What to listen to

`*_wall.wav` is the one to judge: a 3 s held A2 (does the wall hold), a held power chord, three 300 ms power-chord stabs, one low A1 (does it bark). `*_stabs.wav` and `*_riff.wav` are the pilot phrases (the riff is single notes: a fuzz on single low notes is the harsh case).
Listen for: the size of the wall (B against D's DUAL), the sustain, whether C's higher GROWL and BIAS spit or just squash, the very short punch of the strike, and whether the tail after a note is a slight tail or too long.

*Notes.* Level is read on the note-on region of the wall phrase (phrase k) and is a heavily compressed signal: the crest factor of the held note is 2.3 dB (a square is 0 dB, a sine 3), so RMS and peak sit close together;
phrase (b), with its three-note chords, reads about 2 dB hotter than the wall phrase, outside the +-1.5 dB band. GROWL leaves the loudness nearly where it was (its static law and slow trim) so it is the VOLUME that is trimmed. The attack probe strikes a high note (A5, 1.1 ms period) from silence so that the millisecond-scale attack is resolvable; the fuzz stage's loudness trim
makes a note from silence start a little under its plateau. TONE moves the centroid (1251 -> 2051 Hz for 25 -> 90), BIAS only the peak (+0.8 dB for 15 -> 80): the probe tables. Existing controls only: no gate, no octave-up fuzz. Variant A is rendered through the base program path.
